Name: Shane's Game Room for Two
Author: calophi
Description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/HMxUFCD.png[/img]

This mod was inspired by the other "clean Shane's room" mods out there, but I wanted something simple. I also thought it'd be nice if he wanted to play games with me, so I've added in a cushion. A game room for two!

[list]
[*]Works well alongside of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21660]I Fixed Him - a Shane Consistency Mod[/url].
[*]For[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22955] Immersive Shane[/url]﻿, please turn off "Shane Spouse Room Changes" and then it will work.
[/list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/x9CbYeQ.png[/img]﻿

[b]Recolors[/b]

[list]
[*]Should be compatible with most recolors by default. Please load this mod AFTER recolor tilesets have been loaded
[*]If your recolor mod has modified the game console, let me know and I'll provide a new "console for two" sprite for that recolor.
[*]If any recolor looks off please let me know!
[*]For [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21085]Starblue Valley[/url]﻿ please disable the Clean Shane's Room option, I do not know if that will interfere.
[*]Compatible with  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6098]Rustic Country Town Interiors[/url]
[/list]
[b]Custom Farmhouses[/b]

[list]
[*]Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14411]Aimon's Fancy Farmhouse[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16438]Aimon's Tidy Cozy Farmhouse[/url]﻿
[*]Other farmhouse mods are untested, let me know if one has issues
[/list]
[b]Other Spouse Room Mods[/b]

[list]
[*]All polyamory mods are untested
[*]Custom Spouse Rooms is untested
[*]This mod only touches Shane's room so in theory can be used with other spouse room mods that do not modify his room, provided it does work with your chosen polyamory mod to begin with.
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13906]Less Ugly Spouse Rooms[/url]﻿ - Uncheck the "Shane's SR" option
[/list]
